tool_input.command:
gh pr create --title "fix: vendor .punt-labs/ethos/ inline per repo-only policy" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary

- Vendor the `punt-labs/team` identity registry inline at `.punt-labs/ethos/` (identities, personalities, talents, roles, teams, writing-styles, agents, ethos.yaml) — plain committed files, matching lux, cryptd, public-website, and punt-labs itself, per org policy in `punt-labs/CLAUDE.md` ("Team Registry").
- Correct `.gitignore`: the prior blanket exclusion of `.punt-labs/ethos/` was based on a disproven cone-mode payload-leak theory (already corrected for `.envrc` in PR #239). Cone-mode git-subdir only ever materializes the `path: "plugin"` directory's contents — `.punt-labs/` was never at risk. Replace the blanket exclusion with targeted ignores for machine-local runtime state only (`missions/`, `missions.jsonl`, `sessions/`, `.biff`), mirroring lux's pattern.
- Fix `CLAUDE.md`'s Identity section: this repo does *not* fall back to the global `~/.punt-labs/ethos/` for the team/delegation roster — identities resolve from the repo-local vendored copy, per the org policy correction. Also correct the stale "cone mode always materializes repo root" claim, matching the earlier fix in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` (PR #239).
- Fix `docs/setup-guide.md` Step 9: remove obsolete `git submodule init/update` instructions (never actually used in this repo) and describe the real setup — the vendored copy comes with a normal clone, `ethos enable` just installs hooks.
- `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `[Unreleased]`.

## Why

Caught mid-session while setting up beadle on a new laptop: I incorrectly assumed this repo used the global `~/.punt-labs/ethos/` as a fallback for identity resolution when the vendored copy was thin. The operator corrected me — this repo is repo-only, matching every other Punt Labs repo's documented policy. The `.gitignore` exclusion of `.punt-labs/ethos/` (added for beadle-efv, based on a payload-leak theory already disproven for `.envrc`) was blocking the vendored copy from ever being tracked, which is what caused the confusion in the first place.

## Test plan

- [x] `make check` passes
- [x] `git ls-tree -r HEAD --name-only -- .punt-labs/ethos/` confirms zero mission-runtime files committed (only registry data: identities/personalities/talents/roles/teams/writing-styles/agents + ethos.yaml)
- [x] Secret scan of new tracked content: only descriptive persona bios (cryptography, security terms used as prose, not credentials)
- [ ] Local review agents (code-reviewer, silent-failure-hunter) — pending
- [ ] `ethos doctor` / `ethos identity list` with global `~/.punt-labs/ethos/` moved aside — to reconfirm repo-local resolution works standalone

Docs/config-only change — no runnable code touched; verification is markdownlint + read-through per Phase 3 exception.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)" 2>&1
